# Pulse task #2836: Add track input/output routing pickers, In/Auto/Off monitoring and drag-to-input assignment

Operation: 71e5a3b26905065db32ebb0a3d557e39
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User requests input and output routing drop-downs on tracks, choosing other tracks as sources/destinations; input monitoring In / Auto / Off like Ableton Live; and dragging a track HEADER onto another track's INPUT picker to assign the dragged track as that destination's input. User expects real routing/monitoring, not decorative selectors. This is newly authorized focused work. Existing broad #26/PR190 recording/MIDI, completed #28/PR184 routing and #2790/PR396 final combined-graph validation are context; use their actual existing contracts before inventing a second graph. #2644/PR260 records the genuine positive-latency live keyboard monitoring gap. No duplicate broad routing or recording PR.

First audit actual canonical audio/MIDI routing commands, valid endpoint types, monitor/arm state and prepared rendering paths. Bind pickers to stable source/destination IDs and signal-appropriate choices. Keep audio vs MIDI distinct on audio, instrument and hybrid tracks; instruments convert MIDI to audio, not every endpoint is interchangeable. Main/default/unassigned targets remain explicit where supported. Return input remains send-derived unless existing typed routing explicitly supports another input; preserve Return/Main pinned layout and applicable output routing. Present unavailable/deleted/stale destinations honestly, never silently retarget by row index/name or create tracks/devices. Inputs and outputs must describe one coherent canonical graph, with no accidental duplicate feed/double output when both sides express the same connection. Resolve actual model questions in a finite architecture note before mutating public contracts.

Reference public monitoring semantics, official Live12 manual17.1 https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/routing-and-i-o/#monitoring : In passes the chosen input regardless of arm and suppresses the track's clip playback; Auto passes input when armed but inhibits monitoring while the track is playing clips; Off disables software monitoring without deleting source clips or the recording path. Implement these semantics against actual Hex transport/clip/record arm state, with explicit tested choices for recording/stopped/live MIDI/held-note transitions and no stuck voices. Preserve existing zero-latency support; #2644's positive compensation must be solved or visibly unsupported, not silently reset delay history or pretend success. Do not add microphone permissions/physical hardware or new recording architecture solely to paint controls; report exact missing capability/dependency and propose focused completion work, keeping this user's full behavior open.

Drag assignment: drag payload captures actual source TrackId/signal type and document generation; dropping onto another header's INPUT picker uses the same validated canonical command as menu selection. It assigns input only, not reorder/move/copy the dragged track or insert a clip/device. Show valid/invalid target feedback, preserve selected/editing state as appropriate, clear ghost/capture on success/refusal/Escape/drop-outside/focus loss, reject stale/deleted IDs and incompatible ports. Whole operation one Undo item, no mutation on invalid drop. Output picker routes current track to selected compatible destination via same model.

Validate COMPLETE final audio graph (typed feeds, sends/Returns, implicit Main) and separate MIDI endpoints/DAG before preparation/publication, reusing396. Refuse self/cyclic/invalid routes visibly and atomically; no implicit feedback engine, auto-dropped edges, duplicate processing or arbitrary source precedence. Preserve solo/mute, sends, latency alignment, envelopes, project tuning, device effects, tails, existing authored/live histories and offline/export semantics. RT thread stays bounded/no allocation/locks/I/O/FFI. Live route changes and project replacement must not publish stale candidates or lose last valid audio on refusal.

Acceptance: actual rendered picker->canonical graph and track-header drag->same routing behavior for audio/MIDI/hybrid compatibility; monitor In/Auto/Off+arm/clip-playing transition matrix; independent two-track PCM/event oracles proving selected feed/destination, no doubled dry signal or unintended Main path; invalid combined-cycle/stale/delete/refusal preserves project/history/runtime; Undo/Redo/save/reopen, held-note/Stop and positive-latency unsupported/supported result explicit. Controls fit shared track header with #2834/438 Return styling, #2835/439 compact mixer fields and #2827/431 header-only/H overview; do not overlap or create hidden hit targets. Keep this one coherent deliverable; record unrelated defects separately.

Source1 owns track-header UI and starts with read-only actual-source boundary audit after current essential421/402 coherent checkpoint. Coordinate Engine/Session/Sampler changes with source4 sole writer and track drag/row/menu fields with source6/source2 before edits. For a major ownership/concurrency/public-contract choice return to primary for architecture review; do not silently implement a speculative global rewrite. Supported canonical intake/one PR, targeted local checks and immutable handoff to sole merger for final required exactsource checks/merge. In Progress while unmerged, Ready for Review only after verified merge. Native listening/hardware checks root-owned serial lane; no live app input/data/MTS/permission/install/quit actions.
